observations: Two hair dryers photographed together on a bedspread.
Black dryer has readable text on the body in photo 2: 'KiKi New Gen Professional Super Turbo 1700W'.
Black dryer's cord looks tangled/worn, casing has visible handling marks (photos 0-3).
Green dryer has no visible brand or model text in any photo; a seam/crack line runs along its barrel in photo 1.
Green dryer is partly wrapped in a crumpled, non-sealed plastic bag, not retail/factory packaging.
No photo shows either unit powered on, blowing air, or heating.
No box, receipt, or warranty card shown for either item.

identity.kind: lot of 2 hair dryers (1 black branded, 1 green unbranded)
identity.model: Super Turbo 1700W (black unit only, per photo 2 casing text)

claims.evidence: No box, seal, or power-on proof in any photo; the plastic wrap is a loose crumpled bag, not factory packaging.
Photo 1 shows a visible seam/crack line and worn cord on the green unit, consistent with used condition.
Bundling is a sales term, not a physical condition; cannot be confirmed or denied from photos.

risks.risk: Neither dryer is shown powered on; either could be non-functional (motor, heating element).
risks.proof: Short video clip of each unit plugged in, switched on, blowing air with visible heat/airflow.

risks.risk: Claimed 'brand new' unit may not actually be unused despite plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photo of original retail box, seal, or purchase receipt for the claimed new unit.
risks.if_unproven: price the 'new' unit as used, not new

risks.risk: Cord or plug damage not visible at this resolution (fraying, exposed wire) is a safety and value issue.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of both plugs and cord along their full length.
risks.if_unproven: price with deduction for possible cord wear

risks.risk: Green dryer's wattage/voltage spec unknown, affecting comparables.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of any nameplate/label on the green unit.

proof_requests: Video of each dryer powered on and blowing air/heat.
Close-up of the green dryer's nameplate/label for wattage and brand.
Photo of original packaging or receipt for the unit claimed brand new.
Close-up of both cords and plugs for wear or damage.
response.reason: Both items are identifiable as basic hair dryers (one with a readable brand/model, one unbranded), and though 'brand new' and working condition are unproven, the lot can be priced at worst case as used/untested pending the listed proofs.
